about_the_game:
Celebrate the launch of Master of Command with this Supporter Pack. A premium Art Book (PDF) and the complete Original Soundtrack (WAV).

*Access these from the game's main menu (bottom-right) or in your installed game files.

The Master of Command — Supporter Pack bundles two premium extras for fans who want to go deeper behind the lines:

What’s included

  • Digital Art Book (PDF, 61 pages)
    Concept art, unit studies, campaign maps, and developer commentary tracing the game’s visual and systems design from sketch to battlefield.

  • Original Soundtrack (44 tracks, including 36 stems - 80 .wavs in total)
    The full score from the Prussian Prologue and beyond, delivered in WAV. Includes tracklist.
